Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 timing.duration = 120 (the sheet gives no link time; 4 s is one tendril sweep cycle); rank 0 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, being struck by a skill); rank 0 statuses[0].ticks = 120 (matches the duration channel at rank 0 (4 s)); rank 0 statuses: revealed 120 ticks; rank 3 timing.duration = 138 (the duration channel at rank 3 (4.6 s)); rank 3 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, being struck by a skill); rank 3 resources[0].ticks = 30 (the sheet says the nodes expand perception; 1 s per link feeds the cathedral's 24 s cooldown without trivialising it); rank 3 resources[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for a newly formed link); rank 3 statuses: revealed 138 ticks; rank 5 timing.duration = 150 (the duration channel at rank 5 (5 s)); rank 5 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, being struck by a skill); rank 5 statuses[1].amount = 25 (five linked enemies slow each by 5% per link, 25% at the cap; the form schema has no per-link scaling, so the cap value is stored); rank 5 resources[0].ticks = 30 (unchanged from the augmented nodes); rank 5 resources[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for a newly formed link); rank 5 statuses: revealed 150 ticks, slowed 150 ticks.

mechanics.stock: Enemies struck by Vespera's skills are linked by a sensor tendril and revealed through cover for 4 s (120 ticks), up to 3 linked at once.
counterplay: Fight outside her tendril reach; linked enemies are revealed through cover for 4 s, so break contact before the next sweep; kill the cathedral to blunt the cooldown refund.

dossier.identity: abyssal regent who senses through tendril nodes, tears local apertures in space and raises the hollow cathedral over a battlefield.
dossier.selectionRationale: the sheet labels her a summoner. roles are striker, breaker, bastion and operator only, so she takes operator, the nearest (elara's hydra summoner is an operator too): she fields a colossal shootable construct and controls space with tendrils and a visibility-suppressing aperture rather than trading damage or soaking it. area denial and a summon on a long cooldown separate her from fable's gardens, elara's hydra and vesper's siphon tethers.
dossier.weaponConcept: the hollow cathedral and control tendril system (spinal backpack with a ceramic armor shell, actuator rings, a control conduit, tendon cables and a sensor array driving six articulated tendrils; manifests a colossal cathedral summon that obeys the summoner)

lore.backstory: regent of a drowned parish whose cathedral was hollowed out by the same disaster that sealed the district. what stayed behind learned to answer her. she carries its choir-loft spine on her back and calls the empty nave across the city when asked, not because she commands it but because it is lonely.
lore.syndicateRecord: raised the hollow cathedral over a rival syndicate's command block and walked out through the silence it left in the signal grid.
lore.psychProfile: serene, unhurried and unreadable; speaks to constructs the way others speak to congregations and to people as though they were already quiet.
lore.combatQuote: “emptiness obeys as well. stand where it is widest.”

iconFamily.subject: a bold cathedral arch dissolving into a single chunky void aperture
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Vespera. Theme: abyssal regent. Subject: a bold cathedral arch dissolving into a single chunky void aperture. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
